reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in our DM: he should call Tamsyn Tolland. On 14 October, in this same DM, Marcus told me Tamsyn is his go-to escalation contact at Quarrendon Freight Lines for the Greywater rollout.

I also told him I don't have a phone number for Tamsyn, so he'll need to get it from his own contacts or the account records.

I didn't use the Quarrendon contacts Ilse and Dana gave me. They told me those privately, and they cover different rollouts.
